verdict.rationale: Extend is fundamentally an API platform. It has a documented API reference with Bearer-token authentication and per-endpoint pages (e.g., file upload), an API quickstart, and official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go. Every processing endpoint (extract, classify, split, parse, edit) supports sync and async modes, and webhooks can be configured via the API, test-mode API keys are available, and an llms.txt makes the docs agent-readable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented (community evidence speaks only to extraction accuracy and the UI kit, not API usage).
